criteria.label: Describes the situation
references: I explain the specific challenge or situation I faced.
There was a problem at work that needed attention.
criteria.tip: Describe the situation or challenge so the interviewer understands the context.

criteria.label: Explains personal actions
references: I took specific steps to solve the problem.
I communicated with coworkers, organized the work, and helped address the issue.
criteria.tip: Explain what you personally did, step by step.

criteria.label: Explains the outcome
references: I explain what happened as a result of my actions.
The team completed the work and I learned from the experience.
criteria.tip: Finish by explaining the result or what you learned.

criteria.label: Listens respectfully
references: I would listen carefully to the customer and acknowledge the concern.
criteria.tip: Start by listening to the customer's concern.

criteria.label: Offers a solution
references: I would verify the order and arrange an appropriate correction or replacement.
criteria.tip: Explain how you would correct the order within workplace policy.

criteria.label: Seeks help when appropriate
references: I would ask a manager for help if I could not resolve the issue.
criteria.tip: Mention when you would ask a supervisor for help.

criteria.label: Recognizes hazard
references: I would identify the unsafe condition and avoid exposing myself or others to danger.
criteria.tip: Explain how you recognize and avoid the hazard.

criteria.label: Reports the hazard
references: I would stop unsafe work and report the hazard to the site supervisor following safety procedures.
criteria.tip: Mention stopping unsafe work and notifying the appropriate supervisor.

criteria.label: Follows site procedures
references: I would follow site safety rules and only resume when authorized and safe.
criteria.tip: Explain that work should resume only when the hazard is addressed safely.

criteria.label: Identifies defect
references: I would identify and document the defect during the pre-trip inspection.
criteria.tip: Describe how you would document the problem.

criteria.label: Reports defect
references: I would report the defect to maintenance or my supervisor according to company procedure.

criteria.label: Avoids unsafe operation
references: I would not operate an unsafe vehicle until the problem is properly addressed.
criteria.tip: Emphasize that you would not drive an unsafe vehicle.
